scope: Verified coordinate/rotation calculation only. Original collision validation, carrying stacked pieces, chain state and animation require additional restoration.
input: tipoResor is one action character extracted from sz...ez, not the first fijo character.

configuration.conResorte: st...et; first character selects first switch channel; optional second character selects second switch channel.
configuration.tipoResorte: sz...ez; one-channel action sequence length1..3; with two switch channels, split by literal c into tipo1 and tipo2, each sequence length1..3.

readableExamples.st12etsz6c5ez: switch1 sequence X+20; switch2 sequence Z+20

configuration.trigger: Update compares managerResorte and positionRes to old values; changes call doPrevio -> doResorte -> collision validation -> doRotation or doMove.
